snippet.title: UFC 6 PRIDE FC Expansion Official Reveal
snippet.description:
Enter the Theatre of War and experience PRIDE FC in a massive expansion for EA SPORTS™ UFC® 6 that brings the legendary Japanese promotion back to life with its unmistakable spectacle, rules, and style of fighting. The expansion features a collection of new PRIDE FC fighters like Kazushi Sakuraba, Takanori Gomi, Wanderlei Silva, and many more.

Fight differently. Trade the Octagon for the PRIDE FC ring, where ropes and corners reshape combat, open weight competition creates unpredictable matchups, and PRIDE FC rules change how you compete in every fight. Unleash an expanded arsenal of soccer kicks, stomps, grounded knees, and other iconic PRIDE FC attacks as you learn a new fighting environment and rethink your strategy.

Experience the spectacle. Hear the legendary Lenne Hardt welcome you to the ring and take the stage with the celebratory Opening Ceremony and Grand Fighter Entrances. Compete inside the Budokan, a massive new 50,000-person arena, backed by new Japanese commentary that captures the unmistakable atmosphere of PRIDE FC.

Survive MMA’s most brutal tournament, in the all-new Grand Prix Mode, choosing from 20 curated PRIDE FC fighters as you battle through a multi-fight tournament where health, stamina, and visible damage carry over and Openweight Fights put you against opponents of dramatically different sizes. 

Create dream match ups. The PRIDE FC ring isn't limited to the legends who competed there. Every fighter available to you in UFC 6 can be used in the PRIDE FC expansion in Fight Now, Quick Fight and Invite a Friend, opening the door to dream fights across generations.

Access PRIDE FC on Dec 11th with the EA UFC® 6 Ultimate Edition or the Ultimate Add-On Bundle https://www.ea.com/games/ufc/ufc-6/buy
